standard.summary: 将模型组件顺序 offload 到 CPU，仅在需要时加载到
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Offloads the model components to the CPU in sequence and loads each back only when needed
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 将模型组件顺序 offload 到 CPU，仅在需要时加载到 GPU。大幅减少显存占用，但会增加延迟。

advanced_en.principle: Sequentially offloads model components to CPU, loading them to GPU only when needed. Drastically reduces VRAM usage at the cost of added latency.
